purpose: Contract-only fresh identity for the confirmatory optimizer-step trajectory panel. Preserve the sealed v0.8P treatment, measurement interface, families, templates, and analysis while applying the v05 digest-only E1 neighborhood-identity exclusion.

opaque_e1_identity_denylist.role: opaque binary membership set only; its entries are not decoded or reported during v06 contract construction

preserved_scientific_design.training_recipe_binding: unchanged; exactly the sealed run-contract identity and hash above
preserved_scientific_design.analysis_binding: unchanged; exactly the sealed analysis-contract identity and hash above
preserved_scientific_design.templates: same frozen p0-p3 surfaces; no novel-template claim

representation_and_matching.radius_matching: For each anchor choose argmin over the eight neutral views of abs(||h_N-h_A||_2 - ||h_S-h_A||_2); deterministic tie-break is ascending SHA-256(anchor_id + '|' + neutral_role).

generator_and_identity.source_policy: These exact source hashes are inherited from the sealed original panel-design contract. No generator, feature, matcher, or sealer source was opened or executed to construct v06. Any later P-specific adapter must have its own source hash and tests sealed before a separate panel-generation authorization.

generator_seed_derivation.label: jev-information-density-v08p-v06/fresh-panel-generator-seed
generator_seed_derivation.algorithm: SHA-256(UTF-8(label)); interpret the first four digest bytes as unsigned little-endian u32

generator_and_identity.freshness: New v06 partition namespace and seed; never copy or read v01/v02 generated panel material. Preserve the frozen family and template surfaces.

per_family_candidate_sequence.format: six-digit zero-padded sequence within family and v06 partition namespace

canonicalization.input: authoritative neighborhood_id string emitted by the frozen identity constructor
requirements: no leading or trailing Unicode whitespace
canonicalization.normalization_action: reject if a requirement fails; do not trim, normalize, case-fold, or otherwise rewrite
canonicalization.bytes: exact UTF-8 encoding of the validated string
canonicalization.digest: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of those exact bytes

identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.membership_rule: For each generated candidate n, compute SHA256(UTF8(canonical(n))). Reject iff that digest is a member of the sealed v05 denylist D.
identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.collision_order: Compute and validate the neighborhood identity and its digest before committing the candidate body to any panel output. The membership result is the only E1-derived decision input.
identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.collision_reporting: Record aggregate collision counts by family and sequence index only. Never emit a colliding raw neighborhood_id or the matched denylist digest; never reveal any denylist entry or historical E1 metadata.
identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.collision_retry_rule: Within each family, scan the fixed sequence stream in ascending order 000000 through 001999. A denylist collision rejects only that candidate identity and advances to the next already-defined sequence. Accept the first 500 non-colliding candidates in stream order.
identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.exhaustion_rule: If a family yields fewer than 500 non-colliding candidates by sequence 001999, fail the entire v06 panel identity. Do not enlarge the stream, change the seed/namespace, or relax the rule.
identity_canonicalization_and_denylist.other_failure_rule: Any non-collision identity invalidity, duplicate among accepted P identities, exact-world/schema/surface validation failure, overlap-gate failure, or radius-gate failure fails the panel identity. Do not skip or replace such a candidate.

overlap_and_support.e1_identity_scope: The v05 denylist provides the only E1-derived input: neighborhood identity membership. Do not read E1 panel bodies, raw IDs, candidate joins, features, targets, predictions, metrics, or geometry.
overlap_and_support.p_identity_scope: Require zero duplicate accepted neighborhood IDs across all four families; v06 partition namespace and sequence define new generated identities.
overlap_and_support.training_overlap: Retain the unchanged training-overlap requirement from the sealed original panel-design contract. Any identity-only training scope needed to execute that check must be separately allowlisted under a future panel-construction authorization and match the exact sealed bindings in the original P run contract; if not uniquely resolvable, fail before generation.
overlap_and_support.world_root_episode_and_rendered_input_sc: Retain all original exact-world, family, schema, candidate-order, and training-scope checks. No E1 body-derived comparison is authorized; the v05 neighborhood-ID denylist is not a similarity oracle and supports no claim beyond its identity field.
overlap_and_support.support_failure: Fail the v06 panel identity; no family dropping, reweighting, replacement shopping, or threshold relaxation.

sealing_order: seal exact-world semantic and surface validation
seal fresh candidate/state feature receipts and radius-only match outputs
seal firewall lock with body_access_granted=false and opening_count=0
seal final panel manifest; do not grant trainer or evaluator access
required_panel_outputs_and_seal.panel_claim_scope: Fresh generated world instances within the four fixed semantic families and p0-p3 surfaces; neither novel-template nor novel-family generalization.
